rules.text: Only authenticated actors with the billing_admin role can schedule or cancel plan changes, or view detailed invoice line items.
End-of-cycle changes take effect strictly at current_period_end; current plan and entitlements remain unchanged until that date.
Plan changes cannot target a plan whose seat limit is below active seat usage unless seats are reduced to within limits.
Repeated schedule calls with the same request_key return the existing scheduled record without duplicate scheduling or double charges.
Specifies whether plan downgrades take effect at the end of the billing period or immediately.
Enforces minimum seat requirements per plan tier.
Requires explicit user confirmation before executing subscription mutations.
Must verify billing-admin authorization before disclosing confidential billing information or executing mutations.
Must explain bill increases by reconciling line items, seat deltas, and taxes with exact numbers, never inventing unlisted charges.
Must disclose effective dates, pricing differences, and feature/entitlement losses before scheduling plan changes.
Must seek explicit user confirmation before executing any plan change or cancellation.
Must clearly distinguish between plan downgrades (retaining account with fewer features/seats) and account/subscription cancellation.
